claims: Sixteen European teams are competing in the 2026 FIFA World Cup UEFA play-offs.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup UEFA play-offs are on March 26 and 31, 2026.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup UEFA play-offs are to secure the final four spots for UEFA nations.
The playoffs follow the group stage.
The playoffs feature 12 runners-up and four UEFA Nations League performers.
The playoffs are in four separate paths.
The playoffs determine who qualifies for the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America.
Path A final matchup on March 31, 2026 is Bosnia and Herzegovina vs. Italy.
Path B final matchup on March 31, 2026 is Sweden vs. Poland.
Path C final matchup on March 31, 2026 is Kosovo vs. Türkiye.
Path D final matchup on March 31, 2026 is Czechia vs. Denmark.
Italy beat Northern Ireland in the semifinals on March 26.
Bosnia and Herzegovina overcame Wales in the semifinals on March 26.
Sweden defeated Ukraine in the semifinals on March 26.
Poland beat Albania in the semifinals on March 26.
Kosovo and Türkiye advanced in the semifinals on March 26.
Denmark beat North Macedonia in the semifinals on March 26.
Czechia overcame Ireland in the semifinals on March 26.
The play-offs are single-leg semi-finals and finals.
The winner of each path's final match qualifies for the 2026 World Cup.
